consulting and bookkeeping, help retailers save time and focus on growing their business.

customers — providing great products and great savings for every shopper and for every family.

# Helping *Hometown* **Grocers**
# Across America Thrive

For more than 107 years, we’ve helped hometown grocers — from national chains to single-store
operators — serve their communities. Through innovative supply chain solutions, quality products and
services, and trusted retail experiences, we help keep shelves stocked and families fed across the
country.

## Our Stores & Services

### Financial Services

Discover how our comprehensive financial services, including payroll, accounts payable, tax
consulting and bookkeeping, help retailers save time and focus on growing their business.

[ About Financial Services ][80]

### Food Safety Services

As a food solutions company that has earned consumer trust for more than 107 years, C&S understands
the importance of having rigorous standards and training for food safety.

[ About Food Safety Services ][81]

### Marketing Services

C&S offers marketing support to elevate your brand, including cutting-edge technology and
industry-leading insights — all designed to enhance your promotional strategies, from digital
advertising to community engagement.

[ About Marketing Services ][82]

### Pharmacy Solutions

Our pharmacy services leverage collective buying power across 2,500 independent pharmacies to
guarantee lower operational costs for you and better health outcomes for the community you serve. 

[ About Pharmacy Solutions ][83]

### Our Stores

The C&S family of companies includes more than 200 grocery stores in 12 states, in addition to
dozens of pharmacies and fuel centers with convenience stores.

[ About Our Stores ][84]

### OurBrands

OurBrands are carried in company-operated stores and are distributed to our independent retail
customers — providing great products and great savings for every shopper and for every family.

[ About OurBrands ][85]

## Committed to Communities Beyond the Store

At C&S Wholesale Grocers, the families we serve are at the core of everything we do, from combating
hunger to safeguarding the environment. We collaborate with organizations nationwide to make a
lasting impact on the communities where we live and work.

## What Makes Us Different (And Why It Makes a Difference)

All of our food is produced on farms that use
* No antibiotics or artificial growth hormones
* No GMOs
* No synthetic pesticides and herbicides

## But there’s even more behind our label:
* [Original Organic Valley farmers milking their cow.]
  
  ### We’re the OGs of Organic
  
  Before the USDA created official standards, we were already living by our own. In 1988, the word
  “organic” wasn’t regulated. It was more of a philosophy than a label. So we set out to make it
  mean something. Our founding farmers set some of the earliest organic guidelines — ones that
  helped shape today’s national standards.
* ### USDA Certified Organic
  
  Everything our co-op produces and sells under our *Organic Valley*^{®} brand is USDA Certified
  Organic. It isn’t the easiest way to produce food, but we believe it’s the best way. Of course,
  that doesn’t stop us from exploring new ways to improve upon our time-honored methods.
  
  [Old metal organic farm sign that says do not spray.]
* [A young boy watching a caterpillar crawl on a leaf. ]
  
  ### Protecting Your Food (And Where it Comes From)
  
  Organic Valley is protecting over 1,500 organic farms spanning hundreds of thousands of acres of
  organic farmland across the country. That’s land that is protected from toxic pesticides and home
  to countless plants and animals — land that can help reverse the effects of climate change.
* ### We’re a Farmer-Owned Cooperative
  
  The people who milk the cows, tend the land, and care for the animals are the same people who own
  the cooperative. We’re invested in doing things the right way, not cutting corners for a profit.
  Our farmers get a fair price for what they produce, animals are treated with care, and you get
  food that’s organic, not organic-ish.
  
  [Farmers having a meeting in a barn with haybales and a tractor.]
* [A close up of a cows mouth eating lush green pasture. ]
  
  ### Our Cows Spend More Time Outside
  
  A lot of dairy cows never see a blade of grass.** Because our farms are certified USDA organic,**
  our cows get year-round access to the outdoors when the weather is safe, and spend more than 120
  days grazing on pasture each year — feeling sunshine, grazing freely, and producing milk that’s
  packed with nutrition.
* ### Small Herds. Big Care.
  
  Our average herd size is just 70 cows, which is much smaller than the national herd size average.
  This means our farmers spend a lot of time tending to and caring for their farms and the life on
  those farms and can spot subtle changes quickly — like a cow eating less or lagging behind the
  herd — this helps address potential issues right away.
  
  [Organic Valley cows walking to pasture. ]

Fresh air, sunshine, clean water, and soil rich with life. Because when you keep it simple, food

# Farmers for our future.

Farming has always been about feeding communities and nurturing the land. Today, this remains the
goal of millions of hard-working farmers worldwide. Technology is opening new horizons for them,
allowing them to produce more food with less resources, a vital goal in a planet with growing needs.
Our Farmer-First strategy is about understanding farmers’ pain points so we can better serve them. 

[ 2025 Annual Report ][84] [ 2025 Sustainability Suite ][85]
[Together, we’re helping change the world for good.]

## Legacies of the Land

A U.S. campaign honoring 250 years of farming heritage**
American farming families have shaped the land for generations.**

*Legacies of the Land* brings their stories forward — told in their own words, on the farms they
call home.

[ Watch the stories ][86]
[Fendt RoGator 600 Series]

## A proud portfolio of legendary brands.

AGCO's leading brands support farmers as they transform the agricultural industry. Our innovative
solutions and a Farmer-First mentality are changing the landscape for farmers across the world.

[ View our brands ][87]
[Sowing with a Fendt ]

## Sowing the seeds of ingenuity.

AGCO's precision technologies are revolutionizing the way we farm the land. By harnessing the power
of innovation, farmers can now achieve higher yields with fewer resources.

## [About Carwari][51]

We are a leading certified organic manufacturer of sesame seed products in Australia.


Our signature product is "Black Tahini (Black Sesame Paste)" which is ground by a large stone mill.
All of our Tahini products are very smooth and creamy. 


We also have a wide and diverse range of nuts, seeds, grain products and certified organic Japanese
condiments which are made in Japan.


For more story about us, please click [here][52].

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

quality vegetables to produce partners up and down the East Coast. Proudly serving the Mid-Atlantic
since 1936, we have built our business on reputation, quality, dependability, and service!
[Fresh Fruit & Vegetables][23]

# Organic Program

We're passionate about organic produce and the benefits they provide to consumers and to the
environment. That's why we partner with the best local growers to offer the highest quality,
certified organic products!
[Organics][24]

Who loves saving time in the kitchen? We do, and we know you do too! That's why we launched CPG
Fresh Cuts, our Fresh Cut Processing program that distributes fresh, pre-sliced fruits and
vegetables!
[Fresh Cut Processing][25]

# The Cooperative Choice for Organic Farmers

[Organic Valley, Organic Prairie, and CROPP Cooperative logos]

## Creating Our Future Together

Organic Valley is the nation’s largest farmer-owned organic cooperative, and one of the
world's largest organic consumer brands.

Our cooperative serves more than 1,500 organic family farms. Our member-farms make up 9% of all U.S.
certified organic farms and produce more than 30% of the organic milk sold in the United States.

Organic Valley farmer-owners enjoy some of the world’s highest dairy pay prices, and world-class
veterinary, agronomy and financial tools, designed especially for organic sustainability and profit.

Organic Valley members also produce organic eggs, meats, produce, forages and grains.

With more than 35 years of experience and a powerful position in today's competitive organic
marketplace, you’re in good company when you farm with Organic Valley.

## Agroecology Uprooted

With food systems and the planet in crisis, what would true resilient, sustainable, and just
solutions look like? The answer may lie in a method called [agroecology][36], a holistic approach to
food, agriculture, nature, and social systems that’s already taking root around the globe.

All five episodes of our latest podcast miniseries are now available to stream.

[Listen now][37]

## We approach our work from a systems perspective.

IATP understands the interconnection between agriculture, trade and climate.

[an illustration of two links, linked together.]
We analyze issue interdependence.

We see how interrelationships between issues within complex societal structures make it challenging
to effect change but also open powerful opportunities.

[An illustration of connected dots. ]
We unpack power dynamics.

We ask who has the power? Who wins and loses? Who is at the table when decisions are made?

[An illustration of a network]
We identify key levers of change.

We identify opportunities for big changes within trade, agriculture and climate policy. And we
propose bold solutions that will bring us closer to our vision.

[What is systems thinking? ][38]

## Agroecology Uprooted

With food systems and the planet in crisis, what would true resilient, sustainable, and just
solutions look like? The answer may lie in a method called [agroecology][36], a holistic approach to
food, agriculture, nature, and social systems that’s already taking root around the globe.

All five episodes of our latest podcast miniseries are now available to stream.

[Listen now][37]

## We approach our work from a systems perspective.

IATP understands the interconnection between agriculture, trade and climate.

[an illustration of two links, linked together.]
We analyze issue interdependence.

We see how interrelationships between issues within complex societal structures make it challenging
to effect change but also open powerful opportunities.

[An illustration of connected dots. ]
We unpack power dynamics.

We ask who has the power? Who wins and loses? Who is at the table when decisions are made?

[An illustration of a network]
We identify key levers of change.

We identify opportunities for big changes within trade, agriculture and climate policy. And we
propose bold solutions that will bring us closer to our vision.

[What is systems thinking? ][38]
[American flags in front of U.S. capitol]

## Eyes on the Trump Administration

As we navigate the changing political landscape, IATP remains committed to our principles, including
evidence, public accountability and human dignity. We have created a hub for our work tracking the
administration’s actions and analyzing their impacts.

## Our Dairy Partners

The standards of checks are very stringent as we follow all the quality checks prescribed by law and
our own super best practices.

Our way out of stationing a QI (Quality Inspector) at every source zone has given us an additional
thrust to be double sure that we give the right milk to our subscribers.

### Farmers

Our farmer own land on the foothills of Sahyadri range of mountains, and are hereditarily into
raising & rearing of buffalo’s along with farming. These farms are surrounded with lush green
nature, misty mountains and free-flowing waterfalls apt for raising cattle.

### Quality Inspectors

Our way out of stationing a QI (Quality Inspector) at every source zone has given us an additional
thrust to be double sure that we give the right milk to our subscribers.
[A2 Cow Milk Supplier]

### Cold Chain

Our Cold Chain keeps the milk in the most required natural form & thus the goodness of the ‘RAW’
milk is glass bottled in its purest form to be delivered at your door step with least human touch.

### Delivery Partners

The delivery partners are the women workforce & we call them, “The Pink Power Force”.

### Laboratory Partners

One of the most prestigious NABL accredited company who is our trusted milk testing partner.

## Our Process

Natural grazing by buffalos at the Sahyadri mountains valley and the its finest organic pure desi
buffalo’s milk

# MVOAI

MVOAI is committed to reestablishing the peace between farming, consciousness and the Laws of
Nature. Our food is certified and marketed under Maharishi Vedic Organic Agriculture, Vedic
principle-based and the highest organic standards.

[ Apply for Certification ][32]

##### Beyond Organic Standards

We combine strict international organic standards and Vedic agricultural wisdom to create food that
is of the highest purity, energy and nutritional value.

##### Certification with Integrity

We accredit and inspect manufacturers to make sure that they follow USDA Organic, International
Organic and Maharishi Vedic Agriculture standards.

##### Consciousness-Based Farming

Our agronomy encourages agronomy in line with Natural Law, improving the soil health, the health of
plants and the environment.

##### Global Impact & Poverty Reduction

Vedic Organic cooperatives and international collaboration empower us to provide sustainable farming
initiatives, which empower communities across the globe.

[pexels-tomfisk-5197443]

About us

## Agriculture in Harmony with Natural Law

MVOAI had been established as a vision to bring back all the knowledge of Natural Law in
agriculture. We think food is more than chemical composition, it is a manifestation of nature
intelligence. Through integrating organic farming and Maharishi Vedic technologies, we will create
food that is healthy to the body, the mind and the environment.
* Commercial Gardening
* Residential Gardening
* Industrial Gardening

[ Learn More ][33]

Our Services

## Comprehensive Certification & Education

##### USDA Organic Certification

Certification of the producers, who are operating under the United States standards of National
Organic Program.

##### International Organic Certification

International certification of producers who wish to be compliant in the international markets.

##### Maharishi Vedic Agriculture Certification

Elective sophisticated certification that acknowledges adherence to Maharishi Vedic agricultural
principles and practices.

##### Research & Scientific Studies

Scientific research on the benefits of Vedic Organic Agriculture and support and collaboration.

##### Global Institute Development

Advice and help in setting up affiliated Vedic Organic Agriculture Institutes around the globe.

##### Farmer Education & Training

Training and materials to assist farmers who want to use Vedic Organic practices.

Why Us

## What Is Missing in Modern Agriculture?

The importance of the relationship between consciousness and the Natural Law in modern agriculture
is frequently ignored. As a result, food systems face:
* Environmental imbalance
* Soil degradation
* Reduced nutrient density
* Economic instability for farmers

MVOAI fills this lost dimension, which guarantees the balance, vitality, and sustainability in the
long run.

[ Learn the Difference ][34]

Testimonials

## Trusted by Farmers, Producers & Global Partners

##### Ireneo Marchesi

— Certified Organic Producer, Europe

MVOAI certification helped us align our farming practices with both international organic standards
and deeper principles of sustainability. The result has been healthier soil, stronger crops, and
increased market trust.”

##### Monica R. Wright

— Organic Farm Cooperative Member, South America

“Since adopting Maharishi Vedic Organic principles, we’ve seen improved crop consistency and greater
environmental balance on our farm. The certification process was thorough, supportive, and truly
educational.”

# Our Guiding Principles

## TRANSPARENCY

[Guiding-Principles-TRANSPARENCY.jpg]

Anyone is welcome to visit the farm anytime. No trade secrets, no locked doors, every corner is
camera-accessible.

## GRASS-BASED

[Guiding-Principles-Grass-Based-.jpg]

Pastured livestock and poultry, moved frequently to new “salad bars,” offer landscape healing and
nutritional superiority.

## INDIVIDUALITY

[Guiding-Principles-INDIVIDUALITY.jpg]

Plants and animals should be provided a habitat that allows them to express their physiological
distinctiveness. Respecting and honoring the pigness of the pig is a foundation for societal health.

## COMMUNITY

[Guiding-Principles-COMMUNITY.jpg]

We believe in integrity food. We should all seek food closer to home, in our foodshed, our own
bioregion. This means enjoying seasonality and reacquainting ourselves with our home kitchens.

## NATURE’S TEMPLATE

[Guiding-Principles-NATURE’S-TEMPLATE.jpg]

Mimicking natural patterns on a commercial domestic scale insures moral and ethical boundaries to
human cleverness. Cows are herbivores, not omnivores; that is why we’ve never fed them dead cows
like the United States Department of Agriculture encouraged (the alleged cause of mad cows).

## EARTHWORMS

[Guiding-Principles-EARTHWORMS.jpg]

We’re really in the earthworm enhancement business. Stimulating soil biota is our first priority.
Soil health creates healthy food.

#### Shizuoka tea

Consistently cultivating quality tea leaves is but one part; the other is the fine art and science
of creating finished green tea. Bringing out highly desirable flavor from raw tea leaves requires a
delicate balance of creativity and skill. There are numerous ways of producing green tea, and the
tea master must follow precise steps taken in a timely manner. It is believed tea cultivation and
production in Shizuoka began during the Kamakura Period (1185-1333). The result of centuries of
accumulated blending and processing wisdom and mastery is evident in each new cup of Shizuoka green
tea.

#### Trusted Source for Premium Japanese Green Tea

ShizuokaTea.com sources the best available Japanese green tea from large, medium and small size
processing/packaging companies, and also directly from tea farmers. Our major suppliers collectively
have hundreds of years of experience, are highly skilled, operate very clean facilities and are ISO
Certified, which is very important in a time when there is concern for food safety. We are in
constant contact with the Japanese green tea industry from our year-around staffed buying office in
Shizuoka, Japan in an effort to bring our valued customers superior quality products.

pastures of one of the most beautiful and remote dairy farming regions of the world.

## What Makes Us Different (And Why It Makes a Difference)

All of our food is produced on farms that use
* No antibiotics or artificial growth hormones
* No GMOs
* No synthetic pesticides and herbicides

## But there’s even more behind our label:
* [Original Organic Valley farmers milking their cow.]
  
  ### We’re the OGs of Organic
  
  Before the USDA created official standards, we were already living by our own. In 1988, the word
  “organic” wasn’t regulated. It was more of a philosophy than a label. So we set out to make it
  mean something. Our founding farmers set some of the earliest organic guidelines — ones that
  helped shape today’s national standards.
* ### USDA Certified Organic
  
  Everything our co-op produces and sells under our *Organic Valley*^{®} brand is USDA Certified
  Organic. It isn’t the easiest way to produce food, but we believe it’s the best way. Of course,
  that doesn’t stop us from exploring new ways to improve upon our time-honored methods.
  
  [Old metal organic farm sign that says do not spray.]
* [A young boy watching a caterpillar crawl on a leaf. ]
  
  ### Protecting Your Food (And Where it Comes From)
  
  Organic Valley is protecting over 1,500 organic farms spanning hundreds of thousands of acres of
  organic farmland across the country. That’s land that is protected from toxic pesticides and home
  to countless plants and animals — land that can help reverse the effects of climate change.
* ### We’re a Farmer-Owned Cooperative
  
  The people who milk the cows, tend the land, and care for the animals are the same people who own
  the cooperative. We’re invested in doing things the right way, not cutting corners for a profit.
  Our farmers get a fair price for what they produce, animals are treated with care, and you get
  food that’s organic, not organic-ish.
  
  [Farmers having a meeting in a barn with haybales and a tractor.]
* [A close up of a cows mouth eating lush green pasture. ]
  
  ### Our Cows Spend More Time Outside
  
  A lot of dairy cows never see a blade of grass.** Because our farms are certified USDA organic,**
  our cows get year-round access to the outdoors when the weather is safe, and spend more than 120
  days grazing on pasture each year — feeling sunshine, grazing freely, and producing milk that’s
  packed with nutrition.
* ### Small Herds. Big Care.
  
  Our average herd size is just 70 cows, which is much smaller than the national herd size average.
  This means our farmers spend a lot of time tending to and caring for their farms and the life on
  those farms and can spot subtle changes quickly — like a cow eating less or lagging behind the
  herd — this helps address potential issues right away.
  
  [Organic Valley cows walking to pasture. ]

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA

# The Class Produce Group

We are a family-owned and operated business that distributes only the freshest fruits and highest
quality vegetables to produce partners up and down the East Coast. Proudly serving the Mid-Atlantic
since 1936, we have built our business on reputation, quality, dependability, and service!
[Fresh Fruit & Vegetables][23]

# Organic Program

We're passionate about organic produce and the benefits they provide to consumers and to the
environment. That's why we partner with the best local growers to offer the highest quality,
certified organic products!
[Organics][24]

# CPG Fresh Cuts

Who loves saving time in the kitchen? We do, and we know you do too! That's why we launched CPG
Fresh Cuts, our Fresh Cut Processing program that distributes fresh, pre-sliced fruits and
vegetables!
[Fresh Cut Processing][25]
[Wholesale Produce]

##### Wholesale Produce

We are a wholesale company and not a grower; therefore, we can choose from whom we buy our products.
We only buy from the best growers who pack superior quality!
[CPG Fresh Cuts]

##### CPG Fresh Cuts

We offer a limitless product line of fresh cut fruits and vegetables. Operating out of a modern,
state-of-the-art facility on our campus, we provide full service processing for some of the top
names in the industry!
[Locally Sourced]

##### Locally Sourced

We are proudly committed to sourcing local fruits and vegetables! Our local sourcing program allows
us to keep produce prices down and provide affordable selections that are fresh and healthful. Our
passion for partnering with local farmers gives us the ability to support local economies, provide
fresh food offerings, reduce shipping costs, and lessen our carbon footprint! [VIEW OUR LOCAL BOOK
[PDF]][26]
[Fruit Baskets]

##### Fruit Baskets

Show you're thinking of them and you care! Your gift of a Class Produce Group Fruit basket is a
great way to say "Get Well, Thank You or Congratulations!" Our tradition of excellence has been
extended to include a great selection of fruit baskets to meet your needs and delight the recipient!

farmworkers and communities in their path. Users of pesticides like glyphosate have begun to sue
producers for liability in their cancers. These cases touch on questions about who is harmed by
chemical-intensive agriculture, and who pays the price.

## Agroecology Uprooted

With food systems and the planet in crisis, what would true resilient, sustainable, and just
solutions look like? The answer may lie in a method called [agroecology][36], a holistic approach to
food, agriculture, nature, and social systems that’s already taking root around the globe.

All five episodes of our latest podcast miniseries are now available to stream.

[Listen now][37]

## We approach our work from a systems perspective.

IATP understands the interconnection between agriculture, trade and climate.

[an illustration of two links, linked together.]
We analyze issue interdependence.

We see how interrelationships between issues within complex societal structures make it challenging
to effect change but also open powerful opportunities.

[An illustration of connected dots. ]
We unpack power dynamics.

We ask who has the power? Who wins and loses? Who is at the table when decisions are made?

[An illustration of a network]
We identify key levers of change.

We identify opportunities for big changes within trade, agriculture and climate policy. And we
propose bold solutions that will bring us closer to our vision.

[What is systems thinking? ][38]
[American flags in front of U.S. capitol]

## Eyes on the Trump Administration

As we navigate the changing political landscape, IATP remains committed to our principles, including
evidence, public accountability and human dignity. We have created a hub for our work tracking the
administration’s actions and analyzing their impacts.

# MVOAI

MVOAI is committed to reestablishing the peace between farming, consciousness and the Laws of
Nature. Our food is certified and marketed under Maharishi Vedic Organic Agriculture, Vedic
principle-based and the highest organic standards.

[ Apply for Certification ][32]

##### Beyond Organic Standards

We combine strict international organic standards and Vedic agricultural wisdom to create food that
is of the highest purity, energy and nutritional value.

##### Certification with Integrity

We accredit and inspect manufacturers to make sure that they follow USDA Organic, International
Organic and Maharishi Vedic Agriculture standards.

##### Consciousness-Based Farming

Our agronomy encourages agronomy in line with Natural Law, improving the soil health, the health of
plants and the environment.

##### Global Impact & Poverty Reduction

Vedic Organic cooperatives and international collaboration empower us to provide sustainable farming
initiatives, which empower communities across the globe.

[pexels-tomfisk-5197443]

About us

## Agriculture in Harmony with Natural Law

MVOAI had been established as a vision to bring back all the knowledge of Natural Law in
agriculture. We think food is more than chemical composition, it is a manifestation of nature
intelligence. Through integrating organic farming and Maharishi Vedic technologies, we will create
food that is healthy to the body, the mind and the environment.
* Commercial Gardening
* Residential Gardening
* Industrial Gardening

[ Learn More ][33]

Our Services

## Comprehensive Certification & Education

##### USDA Organic Certification

Certification of the producers, who are operating under the United States standards of National
Organic Program.

##### International Organic Certification

International certification of producers who wish to be compliant in the international markets.

##### Maharishi Vedic Agriculture Certification

Elective sophisticated certification that acknowledges adherence to Maharishi Vedic agricultural
principles and practices.

##### Research & Scientific Studies

Scientific research on the benefits of Vedic Organic Agriculture and support and collaboration.

##### Global Institute Development

Advice and help in setting up affiliated Vedic Organic Agriculture Institutes around the globe.

##### Farmer Education & Training

Training and materials to assist farmers who want to use Vedic Organic practices.

Why Us

## What Is Missing in Modern Agriculture?

The importance of the relationship between consciousness and the Natural Law in modern agriculture
is frequently ignored. As a result, food systems face:
* Environmental imbalance
* Soil degradation
* Reduced nutrient density
* Economic instability for farmers

MVOAI fills this lost dimension, which guarantees the balance, vitality, and sustainability in the
long run.

[ Learn the Difference ][34]

Testimonials

## Trusted by Farmers, Producers & Global Partners

##### Ireneo Marchesi

— Certified Organic Producer, Europe

MVOAI certification helped us align our farming practices with both international organic standards
and deeper principles of sustainability. The result has been healthier soil, stronger crops, and
increased market trust.”

##### Monica R. Wright

— Organic Farm Cooperative Member, South America

environmental balance on our farm. The certification process was thorough, supportive, and truly
educational.”

#### [Family-centered Farm Growth: Country Sunrise Creamery, Meyerstown, PA Owned and operated by
#### the Nelson Martin Family][86]

[[Family-centered Farm Growth: Country Sunrise Creamery, Meyerstown, PA Owned and operated by the
Nelson Martin Family]][87]

By Amy Anselm, NODPA Contributing Writer, of Tioga Family Farm, Truxton, NY

Nelson Martin is the only son of dairy farmers with nine children of his own – and that family
dynamic has long been the driver of Country Sunrise Creamery’s generational evolution and continued
growth. The farm began as a traditional dairy, over time has dabbled in conventional confinement
operations, and more recently has invested in silvopasture and regenerative agriculture practices to
arrive at their current system: not-quite-100% grass-fed, not-quite-organic, but perfectly balanced
for their family’s goals and values. Today the farm sells raw milk from a milking herd of 35 cows,
operates a farm stand, and recently launched a commercial-scale poultry production facility, all on
a total of 120 acres.

[[26th Annual NODPA Field Days Hope for the Future: Strategies for Success, Berks County
Agricultural Center, 1238 County Welfare Road, Leesport, PA 19533]][95]

By Nora Owens, NODPA Field Days Coordinator

When NODPA Field Days were last held in Pennsylvania, in Reedsville in 2023, we had a great crowd of
farm families attend, so this year, when we return to Berks County, just northeast of Lancaster
County, we look forward to an excellent meeting and a great turnout. No one wants to repeat the
climate and feed challenges that many farmers faced in 2025 so we’ve designed a program that focuses
on strategies to make the most of what you have, whether it’s better pasture management, cow health
management, and renewable energy strategies to lower energy expenses, or rethinking profit,
reinvestment and retirement. **[Visit the webpage for more information and to register.][96]**

# Our Guiding Principles

## TRANSPARENCY

[Guiding-Principles-TRANSPARENCY.jpg]

Anyone is welcome to visit the farm anytime. No trade secrets, no locked doors, every corner is
camera-accessible.

## GRASS-BASED

[Guiding-Principles-Grass-Based-.jpg]

Pastured livestock and poultry, moved frequently to new “salad bars,” offer landscape healing and
nutritional superiority.

## INDIVIDUALITY

[Guiding-Principles-INDIVIDUALITY.jpg]

Plants and animals should be provided a habitat that allows them to express their physiological
distinctiveness. Respecting and honoring the pigness of the pig is a foundation for societal health.

## COMMUNITY

[Guiding-Principles-COMMUNITY.jpg]

We believe in integrity food. We should all seek food closer to home, in our foodshed, our own
bioregion. This means enjoying seasonality and reacquainting ourselves with our home kitchens.

## NATURE’S TEMPLATE

[Guiding-Principles-NATURE’S-TEMPLATE.jpg]

Mimicking natural patterns on a commercial domestic scale insures moral and ethical boundaries to
human cleverness. Cows are herbivores, not omnivores; that is why we’ve never fed them dead cows
like the United States Department of Agriculture encouraged (the alleged cause of mad cows).

## EARTHWORMS

[Guiding-Principles-EARTHWORMS.jpg]

We’re really in the earthworm enhancement business. Stimulating soil biota is our first priority.
Soil health creates healthy food.

#### Shizuoka tea

Consistently cultivating quality tea leaves is but one part; the other is the fine art and science
of creating finished green tea. Bringing out highly desirable flavor from raw tea leaves requires a
delicate balance of creativity and skill. There are numerous ways of producing green tea, and the
tea master must follow precise steps taken in a timely manner. It is believed tea cultivation and
production in Shizuoka began during the Kamakura Period (1185-1333). The result of centuries of
accumulated blending and processing wisdom and mastery is evident in each new cup of Shizuoka green
tea.

#### Trusted Source for Premium Japanese Green Tea

ShizuokaTea.com sources the best available Japanese green tea from large, medium and small size
processing/packaging companies, and also directly from tea farmers. Our major suppliers collectively
have hundreds of years of experience, are highly skilled, operate very clean facilities and are ISO
Certified, which is very important in a time when there is concern for food safety. We are in
constant contact with the Japanese green tea industry from our year-around staffed buying office in
Shizuoka, Japan in an effort to bring our valued customers superior quality products.

#### Shizuoka tea

Consistently cultivating quality tea leaves is but one part; the other is the fine art and science
of creating finished green tea. Bringing out highly desirable flavor from raw tea leaves requires a
delicate balance of creativity and skill. There are numerous ways of producing green tea, and the
tea master must follow precise steps taken in a timely manner. It is believed tea cultivation and
production in Shizuoka began during the Kamakura Period (1185-1333). The result of centuries of
accumulated blending and processing wisdom and mastery is evident in each new cup of Shizuoka green
tea.

#### Trusted Source for Premium Japanese Green Tea

ShizuokaTea.com sources the best available Japanese green tea from large, medium and small size
processing/packaging companies, and also directly from tea farmers. Our major suppliers collectively
have hundreds of years of experience, are highly skilled, operate very clean facilities and are ISO
Certified, which is very important in a time when there is concern for food safety. We are in
constant contact with the Japanese green tea industry from our year-around staffed buying office in
Shizuoka, Japan in an effort to bring our valued customers superior quality products.
